entry.name: pollIntervalSec
entry.label: Refresh interval (seconds) while the popup is closed

entry.name: showNetwork
entry.label: Show network shares and cloud drives (polls cloud status too)

entry.name: showUnmounted
entry.label: Show plugged-in but unmounted drives (with a Mount button)

entry.name: thumbMaxGb
entry.label: USB disks this size or smaller count as thumb drives

entry.name: minUnmountedMb
entry.label: Hide unmounted partitions under this many MB (EFI/boot helpers)

entry.name: fullWarnPct
entry.label: Usage bars and the panel glyph turn urgent at this fill percentage

entry.name: glyphFontFamily
entry.label: Font family for drive glyphs (e.g. a Nerd Font); empty = widget default

entry.name: cloudRemotes
entry.label: Space/comma-separated rclone remotes to show; empty = all remotes

entry.name: unlockCommand
entry.label: Terminal command template for LUKS unlock; {dev} is the device path

entry.name: sharesJson
entry.label: Host-specific share inventory as a JSON array (see README)
